character_facts: The silver-armored fighter is willing to sacrifice his own arm to carry out an attack plan.
He is tactically minded and uses deception, poison, and concealed explosives.
The giant golden being physically bites through armored flesh or a limb with ease.
At least one other combatant or observer believes the giant had a broader plan that can be thwarted.
characters_present: A silver-armored fighter with dark hair, who sacrifices his arm as part of a plan
A giant golden humanoid being addressed as a 'holy deity' or god
Multiple armored soldiers or troops observing or fighting in the surrounding battle
Large dark clawed or monstrous figures visible at the edges of the tall battle scene
continuity_links: This page depicts an ongoing confrontation between the armored fighter and the giant golden godlike being.
The page also continues a larger mass battle already in progress around them.
The final dialogue implies the giant had an established plan preceding this moment.
dialogue_meaning: The armored fighter taunts the giant being and invites it to eat him as a trap.
After losing his arm, the fighter explains the consumed flesh was poisoned and internally weaponized.
He says the internal bombs are designed to trigger upon contact with the being's stomach fluids.
Another speaker declares the giant's scheme has failed and dismisses its bravado.
locations: A large bright interior battlefield or vertical chamber
The immediate close-quarters space at the giant being's mouth and upper body
A lower platform or ledge where armed soldiers look upward
lore_facts: The giant golden being is treated by other characters as a deity or godlike entity.
This being is believed to be invulnerable externally, but characters think it can be harmed from within.
Miniaturized bombs can be concealed inside a prosthetic or armored limb and activated by digestive fluids.
The conflict is occurring amid a large-scale battle involving many armored combatants and aerial or falling movement through a vast space.
plot_events: An armored fighter provokes a giant golden being into eating him or at least biting off his arm.
The giant being bites down and tears off the fighter's arm.
The fighter reveals the flesh or arm was poisoned and rigged with mini-bombs.
He claims the bombs will react with the being's gastric fluids and make it implode.
Other combatants nearby respond that the giant's plan has been foiled.
The wider battle continues around them with many troops falling or flying through a huge open space.
uncertainties: The exact identities and names of the armored fighter, the giant golden being, and the surrounding troops are not given on this page alone.
One speech balloon in the last panel is partially attributed by placement only; the exact speaker is visually ambiguous.
The dark figures at the sides of the tall right-hand panel may be creatures, machinery, or architectural elements; the page does not clearly define them.
visual_summary: A silver-armored fighter is partly inside the mouth of a large golden, godlike humanoid creature and goads it into biting down. The creature bites off the fighter's arm, spraying blood. The fighter then reveals this was intentional: his severed arm was loaded with mini-bombs that will react inside the creature's stomach. Around them, a large battle continues in a vast bright chamber or shaft filled with flying and falling armored troops, explosions, and looming dark creatures or machine-organic forms at the edges. In the final panel, soldiers below look upward as the confrontation continues overhead.
